name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery bulk ordering, artwork review, and WooCommerce My Account experience.
changelog:
1.2.5

  • Replaces the redundant My Account Dashboard shortcut band with a customer-focused Current Project hub.
  • Keeps the personal greeting, adds action-needed artwork alerts only when the customer must act, adds an active-order workflow, and retains Recent Orders.
  • Adds a restrained Start Another Project action and responsive project-hub layouts using the All Star navy/gold/cream Crafted Commerce system.
  • Retains the v1.2.4 two-container account shell and approved mobile Account menu.
  • No Supplier Sync pricing, ASBO tiers, cart, shipping, checkout, artwork persistence/review, authentication, or order-security behavior changed.
